messages:
jeff (release-manager): Heads-up — planning a coordinated deploy tonight during the 23:00-00:30 UTC change window. This touches API v1.6.0, runtime kernel switch -> v3.2, console schema migration, and a router config pin. Need alignment on pins + canary order. Link to release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/2026-04-23

maria (api): I can bump API to v1.6.0, it's backward compatible for 99% of clients but we need the client-compat smoke tests run before canary. I'll trigger those at t+10m.

sanjay (runtime): Runtime kernel switch requires the batching kernel flag change and a KV-cache eviction. Plan: wave1 on 10% nodes with kv-evict, wave2 full. Note: if cache eviction takes >45s per pod we abort.

linda (console): Console migration is a DB migration that is online but adds a new field to model metadata. We'll run in parallel but hold UI rollout until wave2 passes. Migration job takes ~7m.

arjun (router): Router pin: routing rule `route:api->v1.6` will be added, plus a temporary fallback to v1.5 for 500/5m. Ready to apply route pin after canary ok.

jeff (release-manager): Suggested rollout order: 1) API canary (5%) 2) runtime kernel wave1 (10%) 3) API 50% expand + console migration on shadow 4) runtime wave2 + router pin 5) full API. Rollback criteria: error rate >1.5% or median latency +200ms over baseline for 5m -> rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy bot triggered: create-release 2026-04-23 v1.6.0 | components=[api,runtime,console,router] | window=23:00-00:30UTC

maria (api): Started client-compat smoke tests -> failures 2/120 on legacy-auth. Investigating; not blocking canary but flagging.

sanjay (runtime): runtime wave1 started on shard-a. command: ``kubectl apply -f runtime-v3.2-wave1.yaml``. kv-evict script run: ``/scripts/kv-evict --shard=shard-a``. Observing steady token latencies.

ops-oncall: Observability: watching token-latency, model-serve-5xx, api-5xx. Alerts set: api-5xx > 1% 5m, p50 latency delta >200ms 5m.

deploy-bot: canary-report: api-canary=pass, runtime-wave1=pass, console-migration=running(3m/7m)

linda (console): migration job at 6m, no blockers, schema backward compatible so UI flag gated.

arjun (router): Holding router pin until runtime wave2 completes.

maria (api): client-compat: legacy-auth failures traced to header parsing; patch in CI, will hotfix if still failing at 50% expand.

jeff (release-manager): Decision: proceed to runtime wave2 + expand API to 50% once console migration hits 7m complete. If any of the rollback criteria hit, we immediately revert runtime to v3.1 and pin API back to v1.5.

deploy-bot: runtime-wave2 started on remaining shards. command: ``kubectl apply -f runtime-v3.2-wave2.yaml``

deploy-bot: canary-report: runtime-wave2=pass, api-50% expand=pass, console-migration=success

maria (api): Rolling API to 100% now. Patch for legacy-auth merged, client-compat green.

arjun (router): Applied router pin and fallback rule: ``route.pin(api)=v1.6; fallback=v1.5 if 500/5m``.

deploy-bot: release-complete: all components rolled to target versions. Notes: runtime kernel switched, console migration applied.

ops-oncall: Observability post-check: api-5xx=0.12% (OK), p50 latency delta=+45ms (within SLO). No rollback needed.

jeff (release-manager): Great — thumbs up. I'll send final release note now and close the change window. Reminder: keep an eye on KV cold-start errors over next 2h. If anything, escalate and pin runtime back to v3.1. :thumbsup:
